logic.title: Sunspots

rules.oneSun: Place exactly one sun in every row and every column.
rules.regions: Every colored region also gets exactly one sun.
rules.noTouching: No two suns can touch, not even diagonally.

controls.mark: Tap a cell once to put an X where you know there's no sun. X marks are just your notes.
controls.sun: Tap it again for a sun, and once more to empty it. A sun that breaks a rule is rejected and counts as a mistake.
controls.score: Your score starts at 1000 and goes down with time, and each mistake costs 50 points. Once every sun is placed, the puzzle is solved.
